result.reason: The added covenant reaches the preferred insurance position: CGL at USD 1M/2M, E&O at USD 2M, cyber at USD 5M for a vendor processing Customer Data, workers’ compensation as required by law, and certificates on request. It leaves the existing force-majeure language unchanged. However, requiring all coverage to continue for one year after the term goes beyond the playbook and is not necessary, particularly for occurrence-based CGL and workers’ compensation coverage.
